title: Case 041: Inspection Slot Selection
initial_request: I need help arranging an inspection at 141 Birch Walk, Brackenford, ZZ5 5ZZ. Please let me know what times are available so I can confirm when I can provide access.
overview: Northmere Mutual’s inspection coordinator offered two appointment windows and asked Clayford Cover to arrange access with Millie. Joe sent both options to Millie, who chose the first; Joe passed on her choice and the coordinator confirmed Tuesday 5 August 2025, 10:00–12:00, and Joe passed the confirmed slot back to Millie.

next_action.summary: At the point when access was still unconfirmed, Joe’s next action was to ask Millie which of the two offered slots she could accommodate.

outcome: The insurer’s coordinator confirmed the inspection for Tuesday 5 August 2025, 10:00–12:00, and Millie was notified.

events.from: Ruth Bell, Northmere Mutual inspection coordinator
events.body: We can offer an inspection at 141 Birch Walk, Brackenford, ZZ5 5ZZ, on Tuesday 5 August 2025 between 10:00 and 12:00 or Thursday 7 August 2025 between 13:00 and 15:00. Please check which window works for Millie and let me know her preference.

Northmere Mutual has offered Tuesday 5 August, 10:00–12:00, or Thursday 7 August, 13:00–15:00, for the inspection at your home. Could you let me know which window you can provide access for? Neither option is booked yet.
Tuesday 5 August between 10:00 and 12:00 works for me, and I can provide access then. Please ask the coordinator to confirm that slot.

events.to: Ruth Bell, Northmere Mutual inspection coordinator
events.body: Millie has selected the Tuesday 5 August 10:00–12:00 window for the inspection at 141 Birch Walk, Brackenford, ZZ5 5ZZ. Please confirm whether that time is available.

events.from: Ruth Bell, Northmere Mutual inspection coordinator
events.body: I confirm the inspection for Tuesday 5 August 2025 between 10:00 and 12:00. Please pass the confirmed slot on to Millie.
Ruth at Northmere Mutual has confirmed your inspection for Tuesday 5 August 2025 between 10:00 and 12:00 at 141 Birch Walk. Thank you for arranging access.
